lessons.trigger_condition: The verified Drive package workflow can start from freshness-only stale inputs, perform one fresh collection, and still remain fail-closed because transient provider/output degradation persists; the prior workflow then stops without one final bounded recollection or structured high/medium finding diagnostics.
lessons.prevention_rule: V383 must preserve unchanged freshness and collection quality gates, allow at most two bounded fresh collection attempts only after the explicit stale-only critical set is proven, never upload on degraded or failed verification, print exact critical/high/medium findings after each failed fresh attempt, and keep stale/blocked provider evidence fail-closed without source bypass.
validation_required: only the watched GPT TCG Drive Package workflow changes in the functional candidate
stale-only eligibility remains restricted to STALE_AUTO_UPDATE_REPORT STALE_SOCIAL_SNAPSHOT STALE_SUPPLEMENTARY_SNAPSHOT
freshness and collection verification thresholds remain unchanged
at most two bounded fresh collection attempts are permitted
each failed fresh attempt emits structured critical high medium findings when available
artifact upload remains conditional on steps.package.outputs.ready == true
failed or degraded package generation never uploads stale outputs
no actions write permission or static refresh dispatch is introduced
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V383 improves bounded recovery and observability only; it does not widen freshness thresholds, weaken fail-on-degraded behavior, bypass blocked providers, auto-promote unverified data, write Git/main from runtime, or claim physical Drive application.
